reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideActionCategories selection and uses the existing extractTagsFromText tag parser instead of hand-rolled string matching.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the tag rule is added once in the shared selection function.

placement.why: The rule sits in the single category-selection function in server/budget/actions.ts that every month-wide action already routes through.

scope.why: Only the selection function, one constant and matching tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised; minor nit that the hidden/template rules live in SQL while the tag rule is a JS post-filter and the returned rows carry an extra note field.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all month-wide actions keep calling getMonthWideActionCategories

one_place.where: getMonthWideActionCategories in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by every month-wide action
